songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
I heard the graveyard rattle.
My stomach answered back.

[Verse 1]
Moonlight on a crooked gate,
I missed my supper, working late.
A witch sent bones across the yard;
I caught a shin and bit down hard.
My brother groaned, "You cannot eat
The things that chase us down the street."
I grinned around my stolen prize.
Then something human filled its eyes.

[Pre-Chorus]
A little voice inside the bone:
Please don't leave me here alone.
My jaws went still.
The night grew cold.
What kind of hunger did I hold?

[Chorus]
Bone chewer, heart beneath the fang,
I hear the names the dead once sang.
I came for a fight and a mouthful of trouble;
I'm taking you home from the teeth of the rubble.
Let the witch keep her crown of stone.
She doesn't get to keep your bones.

[Verse 2]
Her cauldron coughed a crawling stain;
It hit my muzzle like cold rain.
I spat green sludge across the grass.
So much for looking fierce with class.
But through the slime a locket shone,
A wedding vow scratched into bone.
She'd tied each soul with copper wire.
The knot was buried in her fire.

[Chorus]
Bone chewer, heart beneath the fang,
I hear the names the dead once sang.
I came for a fight and a mouthful of trouble;
I'm taking you home from the teeth of the rubble.
Let the witch keep her crown of stone.
She doesn't get to keep your bones.

[Bridge]
My daughter waits beside the mill.
Tell her that I love her still.
I'll tell her when the sun comes through.
But first, old friend, I'm freeing you.
I know the ache of empty chairs.
Tonight somebody answers prayers.

[Breakdown]
BREAK THE BINDING!
GIVE THEM BACK!

[Instrumental]

[Verse 3]
I dragged her staff across the rim;
The copper snapped, the light went dim.
She reached for me; I broke the spell
And sent her crashing down her well.
One pale hand brushed my filthy cheek.
The thing with teeth could barely speak.
I left the locket by the mill,
Then sat beside it, wet and still.

[Final Chorus]
Bone chewer, heart beneath the fang,
I know the names the dead once sang.
I came for a fight and a mouthful of trouble;
I carried them home from the teeth of the rubble.
Let the witch keep her crown of stone.
No one has to haunt alone.

[Outro]
My brother brought me bread and stew.
I saved the bigger half for you.
And if that soup contains one bone,
I'm checking that we're quite alone.

songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
Three knocks along the railway.
I know that rhythm anywhere.

[Verse 1]
The tunnel smelled of rain and rust,
Of frightened cubs and burning dust.
A witch had wired the station bells
To ring their names like little spells.
One silver note went through my head;
I hit the rails and tasted dread.
My ears lay flat, my claws lost hold.
The strongest girl there felt six years old.

[Pre-Chorus]
You tapped the track beneath my hand.
A beat my body understands.
Below the noise,
Below the fear,
A road that I can feel from here.

[Chorus]
Under the neon frequency,
Keep one steady beat for me.
When all the bright world breaks to sound,
Your heartbeat is my solid ground.
I cannot hear you call my name;
I know the way you say it all the same.

[Verse 2]
We crawled beneath the speaker rows;
My tail caught sparks, my temper rose.
A perfect stripe of singed-off fur.
I'd send the grooming bill to her.
Behind the glass, our youngest three
Pressed silent mouths against the screen.
She'd bottled every cry they made.
I stood up shaking, still afraid.

[Chorus]
Under the neon frequency,
Keep one steady beat for me.
When all the bright world breaks to sound,
Your heartbeat is my solid ground.
I cannot hear you call my name;
I know the way you say it all the same.

[Bridge]
Three taps means I'm beside you still.
Two more: together, if you will.
I used to lead by tooth and ear.
Tonight I'll let you lead me here.
A hunter learns another way;
Being hurt won't make me prey.

[Breakdown]
BREAK THE CIRCUIT!
BRING THEM HOME!

[Instrumental]

[Verse 3]
I drove her wand between the gears;
The bottles burst like chandeliers.
She fell beneath her iron bell.
Our stolen voices broke the spell.
I counted paws against my chest,
Then let the little ones get dressed.
You touched my hand beside the stairs;
Three quiet taps. A world was there.

[Final Chorus]
Under the neon frequency,
You kept one steady beat for me.
When all the bright world broke to sound,
Your heartbeat was my solid ground.
Now dawn is humming through the train;
I hear you laugh and love the sound again.

[Outro]
My ears still ring. You walk me slow.
The cubs stay close; they seem to know.
And when we reach the market square,
You're buying something for this hair.

songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
Mother stitched this dress by candlelight.
I promised I would keep it white.

[Verse 1]
I tucked my tail beneath the lace,
Rehearsed a harmless human face.
The countess kissed my borrowed glove;
Her perfume hid no trace of love.
A silver fork, a crystal flute,
A wolf girl laced from throat to waist,
With silk and fear I could almost taste.
Below the dance, I scented death.

[Pre-Chorus]
My brother's coat beside her chair.
He never went without it there.
I knew that tear.
I knew that thread.
I heard him breathing with the dead.

[Chorus]
Silk and slaughter, candle flame,
Call me beast, but say his name.
I didn't cross this marble sea
To make these strangers bow to me.
There's someone waiting underneath.
I'll bring him home between my teeth.

[Verse 2]
The dancers wore their borrowed smiles;
Their shadows stretched like crocodiles.
She raised a toast to tame young things
And showed her teeth beneath her rings.
I slit the hem against a blade,
A climbing rope my mother made.
One heel fell down the cellar stair.
So much for making an entrance with flair.

[Chorus]
Silk and slaughter, candle flame,
Call me beast, but say his name.
I didn't cross this marble sea
To make these strangers bow to me.
There's someone waiting underneath.
I'll bring him home between my teeth.

[Instrumental]

[Bridge]
You wore her dress to come for me?
She'd kill us if she saw that seam.
She taught me how to mend a tear,
And how to hold the people here.
A dress can wait. Your hands are cold.
Climb up the silk. I'll take the hold.

[Breakdown]
BREAK THE LOCK!
TAKE HIM HOME!

[Verse 3]
The countess caught us at the stair;
Her velvet split to something bare.
I drove her silver through her heart;
The hungry shadows came apart.
We limped across the waking lawn,
Two ruined shapes against the dawn.
I wrapped him in the ragged train.
Her stitches held him close again.

[Final Chorus]
Silk and slaughter, candle flame,
You called me beast; I called his name.
I didn't cross that marble sea
To make those monsters bow to me.
Now someone sleeps against my sleeve.
We both came home. That's what I keep.

[Outro]
Mother took one look and sighed,
Then pulled us both against her side.
She found my missing heel that spring.
Apparently, I owe her everything.

songs.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I bought the red I'd never dare,
Then practiced smiling at a chair.
Tonight he'd see me in the town;
I brushed my stubborn eyebrows down.
The mirror whispered, "Almost right.
We could improve those teeth tonight."
I leaned too close. It stole my face
And put a prettier stranger in its place.

[Pre-Chorus]
My ears came up; my lipstick slid.
The girl behind the glass just grinned.
She looked like all I'd tried to be.
Why did she look afraid of me?

[Chorus]
Gloss and grit, a crooked smile,
I've been disappearing for a while.
Let me be lovely, let me be wild,
Let me be more than a frightened child.
I want the red. I want the claws.
I want a face that feels like mine once more.

[Verse 2]
The stranger wore my scent like lace
And met him in the market place.
I chased her with my muzzle stained,
My mascara melting in the rain.
She said, "That beast has lost her head."
He saw the pawprints, cherry red.
I'd tracked my lipstick down the lane.
My awful makeup gave me back my name.

[Chorus]
Gloss and grit, a crooked smile,
I've been disappearing for a while.
Let me be lovely, let me be wild,
Let me be more than a frightened child.
I want the red. I want the claws.
I want a face that feels like mine once more.

[Bridge]
He held a lantern to the glass;
I watched a hundred faces pass.
Each one a girl who'd traded skin
To find a place they'd let her in.
I pressed my muddy paw against
The perfect girl I'd learned to chase.
She flinched before I did.
I wanted back my face.

[Breakdown]
GIVE IT BACK!
BREAK THE SPELL!

[Instrumental]

[Verse 3]
I struck the witch behind the shine;
The stolen faces slipped through mine.
She shattered with her silver room.
We swept her promises up with a broom.
He offered me a rag, then laughed:
"Your lipstick's halfway down the path."
I wiped my nose and took his hand.
We'd missed the ball. We found the band.

[Final Chorus]
Gloss and grit, my crooked smile,
I won't disappear to be worthwhile.
Let me be lovely, let me be wild,
Tender and vain and badly styled.
I'll wear the red and keep the claws.
The girl inside the mirror's mine once more.

[Outro]
Tomorrow I can fix the fur.
Tonight I want another dance.
He kissed the cherry off my cheek.
I ruined his clean shirt by chance.

songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
The flowers matched my winter coat.
I had my vows. I cleared my throat.

[Verse 1]
My sister braided pearls all day;
I kept my muddy paws away.
The whole pack gathered by the pine.
For once, the perfect night was mine.
Then Auntie's gift began to hum;
A witch had slipped a curse among
The combs and ribbons by my chair.
One flash. A thundercloud of hair.

[Pre-Chorus]
My veil stood up. The roses smoked.
Somebody laughed. I nearly choked.
The boy I loved was watching me.
A purple fright beside a tree.

[Chorus]
There's static on the veil tonight,
And every ugly spark is bright.
Will you still take this trembling hand
When nothing happens like we planned?
I wanted one thing storms couldn't steal:
To know you'd love the wolf beneath the veil.

[Verse 2]
The witch rose laughing past the guests;
Her next bolt aimed at little chests.
I felt its path along my skin,
The cursed comb drawing lightning in.
I left my pretty place in line
And ran beneath the tallest pine.
The veil tore free; I let it fly.
I'd be the brightest thing beneath her sky.

[Chorus]
There's static on the veil tonight,
And every ugly spark is bright.
Will you still take this trembling hand
When nothing happens like we planned?
I wanted one thing storms couldn't steal:
To know you'd love the wolf beneath the veil.

[Bridge]
I didn't come to marry lace.
I know that fierce, ridiculous face.
Then hold the little ones for me.
I've got a witch above that tree.
My mother's comb is burning blue.
I'll spend its last good spark on you.

[Breakdown]
GROUND THE STORM!
BREAK THE BROOM!

[Instrumental]

[Verse 3]
I caught her broom against the wire;
The curse ran home in silver fire.
She fell. The frightened thunder died.
My sister found me where I cried.
He knelt beside my blackened train
And moved the ribbon from my mane.
The pack stood close to keep us warm.
We said our vows inside the broken storm.

[Final Chorus]
There's static on the veil tonight,
Our little ruined world is bright.
You took my shaking, muddy hand
With nothing left of what we'd planned.
The storm could burn the lace away;
It couldn't take the words we came to say.

[Outro]
One pearl survived. He keeps it still.
My fur took weeks to settle down.
The wedding picture's on the shelf.
Nobody crops the thundercloud.

songs.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The kettle stopped. The fire bent.
I heard her at the garden fence.
My mother, dead three winters now,
Was calling in her going-home sound.
My brother dropped his cup and ran;
I caught his coat with one bare hand.
The voice could make my old scars ache.
The wind brought nothing but the lake.

[Pre-Chorus]
No cedar soap. No flour dust.
No woolen sleeve I used to trust.
Just sweetness where the dark began,
And something waiting for my hand.

[Chorus]
A voice without a scent of home
Is calling through the rain.
I want to be her little girl;
I want that once again.
But love is more than how you sound.
I won't let you lead him underground.

[Verse 2]
She stepped between the hanging sheets;
My mother's smile, a stranger's feet.
She knew the song beside my bed.
She knew the last thing Mother said.
I nearly let my brother go.
I almost chose what couldn't be so.
Then through the grief I caught the smell:
Wet ash and iron from a wishing well.

[Chorus]
A voice without a scent of home
Is calling through the rain.
I want to be her little girl;
I want that once again.
But love is more than how you sound.
I won't let you lead him underground.

[Instrumental]

[Bridge]
What if it's her and we're too late?
What if she's cold outside the gate?
I know. I hear her asking too.
I'd give my winter coat if it were true.
But Mother never made us crawl
Or asked for one to leave them all.
Hold on to me. Don't turn around.
I'll face the thing that stole her sound.

[Breakdown]
LEAVE HER NAME!
LET HER REST!

[Verse 3]
I broke the charm against the stones;
The witch fell back into her bones.
Her borrowed face dissolved like rain.
I lost my mother once again.
My brother caught me at the knee.
This time somebody carried me.
We sat until the kettle cried,
His living shoulder pressed against my side.

[Final Chorus]
A voice without a scent of home
Can never bring her here.
I want to be her little girl;
That wanting won't disappear.
But love is warm beside me now.
We'll keep her name without that borrowed howl.

[Outro]
Her coat still smells of cedar wood.
We leave it hanging where she would.
I make the tea. He locks the gate.
We tell her stories while we wait.

songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
A free new brush. A velvet bow.
I should have known. I should have known.

[Verse 1]
The tailor had a perfect coat
And tiny scissors at her throat.
She promised, "Just a little trim.
We'll make the moon look pale and dim."
I left my loose fur on her floor
And strutted through the shop's front door.
By midnight, every step I tried
Put someone else's pain inside.

[Pre-Chorus]
A needle turned.
My sister cried.
A ribbon tightened
Round her side.

[Chorus]
You took a little lock of me
And stitched it to a thorn.
You don't get every life I love
Because I wished for softer fur.
Pull your thread. I'll pull it free.
You cannot make a doll of me.

[Verse 2]
Behind the shop, beneath the loom,
Our little faces filled the room.
She'd woven what we shed in spring
To tug us round on scarlet string.
My sister's doll was missing breath;
A pinhead hovered at her chest.
I shook so hard my claws withdrew.
I'd brought this home. What could I do?

[Chorus]
You took a little lock of me
And stitched it to a thorn.
You don't get every life I love
Because I wished for softer fur.
Pull your thread. I'll pull it free.
You cannot make a doll of me.

[Bridge]
You wanted care. She sold you shame.
That doesn't make her crime your blame.
Then hold the candle near the thread.
I'll take the pins out of their heads.
I know the scent of every one.
We'll burn the loom when they are gone.

[Breakdown]
CUT THE THREAD!
FREE THE PACK!

[Instrumental]

[Verse 3]
I bit the spool from off its stand;
The witch reached out with borrowed hands.
I caught her sleeve against the wheel
And broke the spell beneath its steel.
We carried every small face out.
My sister woke and tried to shout.
She barely had the breath to say,
"You really paid for that? It's gray."

[Final Chorus]
You took a little lock of me;
We brought each other home.
The moon can have her silver shine;
I have a pack to call my own.
Pull your thread. The knots won't stay.
We're more than what we shed away.

[Outro]
We made a nest from all that thread.
She keeps her little doll in bed.
I bought a brush from someone new.
My sister checks the receipt too.

songs.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Her first full moon came two days late,
Behind the barn, beside the gate.
She hid her hands inside her sleeves:
"What if the wolf part never leaves?"
I showed the scratches on my shoe,
The hole my first tail battered through.
She laughed; then every lantern died.
The thing we barred outside was now inside.

[Pre-Chorus]
A demon sniffed along the stair.
She couldn't shift. She couldn't bear
Another inch of strange new skin.
I put my shaking sister behind me.

[Chorus]
First moon, stay close to me.
You don't have to know what you're going to be.
One breath, then one more breath;
You have a sister on this side of death.
When your own heart sounds like a stranger's drum,
I'll keep the doorway till the morning comes.

[Verse 2]
It wore the face of someone kind;
She almost let it touch her spine.
I hit its teeth against the wall.
The loft caught fire. I heard her fall.
My careful braids went up in smoke,
My good coat stank of burning oak.
She whispered, "Now you're ugly too."
I said, "That's quite enough from you."

[Chorus]
First moon, stay close to me.
You don't have to know what you're going to be.
One breath, then one more breath;
You have a sister on this side of death.
When your own heart sounds like a stranger's drum,
I'll keep the doorway till the morning comes.

[Instrumental]

[Bridge]
One match left inside my sleeve,
One beam left for us to leave.
You needn't be the wolf I am.
Just put your paw against my hand.
Her new claws found the timber grain.
The whole barn shook beneath our weight.
For one clear breath she knew her name.
I saw her choose to live inside the change.

[Breakdown]
HOLD THE DOOR!
LET HER THROUGH!

[Verse 3]
She scrambled through the smoking thatch;
I lit the salt with our last match.
The demon broke against the flame.
I followed when she called my name.
We landed badly in the stream,
Two drowned coats and one wild scream.
Then she began to laugh so hard
I knew we'd made it out of the dark.

[Final Chorus]
First moon, run close to me.
Look at the girl you are learning to be.
One breath, then one more breath;
You pulled your sister back from the edge of death.
Now two hearts answer that uncertain drum.
We kept the doorway, and the morning comes.

[Outro]
She wants her first real brush today.
I show her where I hid mine away.
She says my tail looks rather thin.
I throw the towel. She throws it back again.

songs.title: The Empty Place by the Fire V1
songs.style: English, female-led symphonic power metal, melodic electronicore, synthwave metal, powerful clean female lead singing in verses and choruses, ringing high-register belt, soaring melodic soprano hooks, sustained open vowels, expressive rhythmic phrasing, supporting clean male baritone harmonies, female voice prominent and intelligible, tight downtuned seven-string guitar chugs, melodic twin-guitar leads, driving double-kick drums, punchy snare, distorted supersaw synth hooks, sequenced arpeggios, deep controlled sub bass, orchestral strings, dynamic contrast between intimate passages and explosive choruses, 4/4 meter. Clean melodic singing dominates; harsh vocals are two brief male growled accents in the Breakdown only. Choruses stay entirely clean, with male lower harmony supporting the female lead on their last two lines. 148 BPM. Grief carried into chosen family, epic rather than bleak. A simple piano figure grows into broad symphonic electronic metal with driving drums and a warm supersaw counterhook. Female clean verses begin restrained and gain chest resonance; every chorus is fully sung with wide ascending power-metal phrases. Bridge first two lines are a young adult male survivor in a gentle clean baritone, answered by the female. Breakdown has two brief male growls against the returning demon; Instrumental transforms the opening piano motif into twin-guitar and synth harmony. Verse 3 and Final Chorus build toward a hopeful female high note with male lower support; Outro returns to intimate clean singing.
songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
I set six bowls beside the stone.
The fire and I ate all alone.

[Verse 1]
I'd killed the witch before the thaw;
Her house lay open to the crows.
I thought revenge would make a sound
That brought my pack up from the ground.
Instead, the kettle clicked and cooled.
Their coats still hung on crooked hooks.
I washed the blood from every sleeve
And couldn't make myself believe.

[Pre-Chorus]
One howl went out.
No howl came home.
I left the door
Against the stone.

[Chorus]
There's an empty place beside the fire,
And I won't pretend it's filled.
But someone cold is on the mountain;
Someone out there needs me still.
If I can't bring my people home,
I can make this house a little less alone.

[Verse 2]
I found him by the broken mill,
A stranger holding very still.
A bitten ear, a borrowed coat,
A warning tangled in his throat.
The witch had left one demon bound;
It followed survivors through the town.
He begged me not to let it in.
I took his hand and barred the wind.

[Chorus]
There's an empty place beside the fire,
And I won't pretend it's filled.
But someone cold is on the mountain;
Someone out there needs me still.
If I can't bring my people home,
I can make this house a little less alone.

[Bridge]
I can't be who you lost that night.
I only need a little light.
Then keep your name and keep your face.
You don't have to take their place.
I'll clear a corner by the door.
There's room for grief and something more.

[Breakdown]
HOLD THE THRESHOLD!
LET HIM STAY!

[Instrumental]

[Verse 3]
The demon came in freezing rain;
I met it on the step again.
This time I fought for someone near,
Not for the dead who couldn't hear.
He broke its chain across the stone;
We watched it burn down to the bone.
Then, shaking, he reached for the broom.
I laughed at how he'd read the room.

[Final Chorus]
There's an empty place beside the fire,
And some nights there always will be.
But someone warm is at the table,
Passing half the bread to me.
I couldn't bring my people home.
I kept their fire; it isn't mine alone.

[Outro]
Six old bowls beside the stone,
One chipped blue cup we call his own.
He sweeps the ash. I mend his sleeve.
We leave the door unlocked till eve.
